participants.note: Concept ACK and a variable naming nit
Concept ACK noting stronger compile-time guarantees; nits on comments and parameters
pointed out confusing return-invariant check in LastCommonAncestor and suggested std::reference_wrapper

claims.harm: confusing return-value invariant assumption in LastCommonAncestor
claims.quote: As explained previously, this seems confusing, see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34440#discussion_r3085393412
claims.settled_by_quote: I've double-checked the usages (call sites), and this can't happen -- all chain segments must have the same genesis. Therefore I've changed it to Assert.

support.reason: Changing parameters from const CBlockIndex* to const CBlockIndex& where nullptr is not a valid state improves clarity and gives stronger compile-time guarantees around non-nullability by making the invariant explicit.

result.notes: Initial record. maflcko raised a concern regarding confusing return invariants in LastCommonAncestor, which was resolved by switching Assume to Assert and pushing a fix; stickies-v, musaHaruna, and w0xlt supported the concept.
